reputation_events.comment: Reputation changes for player actions with villages. Values range from -1.0 to 1.0. Negative values decrease reputation, positive values increase reputation.

comment_guide.overview: This configuration defines how player actions affect their reputation with villages.
comment_guide.reputation_range: Reputation ranges from -1.0 (hostile) to 1.0 (friendly), with 0.0 being neutral.

reputation_levels.-1.0_to_-0.5: Hostile - Villagers flee, iron golems attack

comment_guide.trade_discounts: At 0.5+ reputation, each 0.1 gives 10% discount (max 50% at 1.0)
tips: Keep negative values small to avoid making reputation too hard to recover
Keep positive values small for common events (like trades) to encourage many interactions
Use larger positive values for significant achievements (like completing raids)
Ensure major negative events (like killing villagers) are more impactful than minor issues
